  have hQ : (fun theta => coordDeriv 0 (fullAngularField q branch) (logCircle d theta x k))=
      fun theta => deriv (fun r => source q branch d theta r k) x :=
    funext (fun theta => (source_horizontal_derivative q branch d theta x k).symm)
  have he (theta : ℝ) : scalarLaplacian (fullAngularField q branch) (logCircle d theta x k)=
      (Real.exp k:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => source q branch d theta r k)) x+
      deriv (deriv (fun r => source q branch d theta x r)) k-deriv (fun r => source q branch d theta x r) k+
      2*(Real.exp k:ℂ)*deriv (fun t => deriv (fun r => source q branch d t r k) x) theta := by
    have h := source_base_laplacian_integrand q branch d theta x k
    rw [hQ] at h
    linear_combination -h
  have h := congrArg D4BMNativeCircle.average (funext he)
  erw [average_add (((hxx.const_mul ((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2)).add hkk).sub hk1)
      (hgp.const_mul (2*(Real.exp k:ℂ))),
    average_sub ((hxx.const_mul ((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2)).add hkk) hk1,
    average_add (hxx.const_mul ((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2)) hkk,
    average_const_mul,average_const_mul,hz,mul_zero,add_zero] at h
  rw [← average_second hx x,← average_second hk k,← average_derivative hk k] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- The original base Laplacian commutes with the full angular circular mean. -/
theorem angularMean_laplacian_commutes (q : XiZeroCopy) (branch : Bool) (d x k : ℝ) :
    (Real.exp k:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => D4BMFullAngularCircle.angularMean q branch d r k)) x+
      deriv (deriv (fun r => D4BMFullAngularCircle.angularMean q branch d x r)) k-
      deriv (fun r => D4BMFullAngularCircle.angularMean q branch d x r) k=
      D4BMNativeCircle.average (fun theta => scalarLaplacian (fullAngularField q branch) (logCircle d theta x k)) :=
  by simpa only [mean_eq] using mean_laplacian_commutes q branch d x k

private theorem theta_smooth (q : XiZeroCopy) (branch : Bool) (d x k : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun theta => source q branch d theta x k) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro theta
  have hp : 0 < logCircle d theta x k 1 := logCircle_pos d theta x k
  have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fullAngularField q branch) (logCircle d theta x k) :=
    fullAngularField_smooth q branch _ hp
  apply hs.comp theta
  apply contDiffAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp [logCircle,circle,offset,height,denominator]
  all_goals fun_prop (disch := exact (denominator_pos _ _).ne')

/-- The base action of the actual full angular mean retains the complete theta forcing. -/

al_action (q : XiZeroCopy) (d x k : ℝ) :
    (Real.sinh d:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => mean q r x k)) d+
      (Real.sinh d:ℂ)*(Real.cosh d:ℂ)*deriv (fun r => mean q r x k) d=
      (Real.sinh d:ℂ)^2*average (fun theta =>
        scalarLaplacian (fullSquarePotential q) (logCircle d theta x k)) := by
  have hf := radial_family q x k
  have hr := first_slice_continuous hf d
  have hrr := second_slice_continuous hf d
  have ht := theta_smooth q d x k
  have htt := (smooth_derivative (smooth_derivative ht)).continuous
  have hz : average (deriv (deriv (fun theta => source q d theta x k)))=0 :=
    average_periodic_derivative (smooth_derivative ht) (periodic_derivative ht (source_periodic q d x k))
  have h := congrArg average (funext (fun theta => source_darboux_integrand q d theta x k))
  erw [average_add ((hrr.const_mul ((Real.sinh d:ℂ)^2)).add
      (hr.const_mul ((Real.sinh d:ℂ)*(Real.cosh d:ℂ)))) htt,
    average_add (hrr.const_mul ((Real.sinh d:ℂ)^2))
      (hr.const_mul ((Real.sinh d:ℂ)*(Real.cosh d:ℂ))),average_const_mul,average_const_mul,
    average_const_mul,hz,add_zero] at h
  rw [← average_second hf d,← average_derivative hf d] at h
  exact h

private theorem horizontal_theta_smooth (q : XiZeroCopy) (d x k : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun theta => deriv (fun r => source q d theta r k) x) := by
  have he : (fun theta => deriv (fun r => source q d theta r k) x)=
      fun theta => coordDeriv 0 (fullSquarePotential q) (logCircle d theta x k) :=
    funext (fun theta => source_horizontal_derivative q d theta x k)
  rw [he]
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro theta
  have hp : 0 < logCircle d theta x k 1 := by
    exact mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (one_div_pos.mpr (denominator_pos _ _))
  have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fullSquarePotential q) (logCircle d theta x k) :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mpr (fun n => fullSquarePotential_smooth q _ hp n)
  apply (coordDeriv_contDiffAt (m := ∞) (by simpa using hs) 0).comp theta
  apply contDiffAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp [logCircle,circle,offset,height,denominator]
  all_goals fun_prop (disch := exact (denominator_pos _ _).ne')

private theorem horizontal_theta_periodic (q : XiZeroCopy) (d x k theta : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun r => source q d (theta+2*Real.pi) r k) x=
      deriv (fun r => source q d theta r k) x :=
  congrArg (fun f : ℝ → ℂ => deriv f x) (funext (fun r => source_periodic q d r k theta))

/-- The actual base-point Laplacian commutes with averaging the complete original theta half-square. -/
theorem mean_laplacian_commutes (q : XiZeroCopy) (d x k : ℝ) :
    (Real.exp k:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => mean q d r k)) x+
      deriv (deriv (fun r => mean q d x r)) k-deriv (fun r => mean q d x r) k=
      average (fun theta => scalarLaplacian (fullSquarePotential q) (logCircle d theta x k)) := by
  have hx := horizontal_family q d k
  have hk := height_family q d x
  have hxx := second_slice_continuous hx x
  have hkk := second_slice_continuous hk k
  have hk1 := first_slice_continuous hk k
  have hg := horizontal_theta_smooth q d x k
  have hgp := (smooth_derivative hg).continuous
  have hz := average_periodic_derivative hg (horizontal_theta_periodic q d x k)
  have hQ : (fun theta => coordDeriv 0 (fullSquarePotential q) (logCircle d theta x k))=
      fun theta => deriv (fun r => source q d theta r k) x :=
    funext (fun theta => (source_horizontal_derivative q d theta x k).symm)
  have he (theta : ℝ) : scalarLaplacian (fullSquarePotential q) (logCircle d theta x k)=
      (Real.exp k:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => source q d theta r k)) x+
      deriv (deriv (fun r => source q d theta x r)) k-deriv (fun r => source q d theta x r) k+
      2*(Real.exp k:ℂ)*deriv (fun t => deriv (fun r => source q d t r k) x) theta := by
    have h := source_base_laplacian_integrand q d theta x k
    rw [hQ] at h
    linear_combination -h
  have h := congrArg average (funext he)
  erw [average_add (((hxx.const_mul ((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2)).add hkk).sub hk1)
      (hgp.const_mul (2*(Real.exp k:ℂ))),
    average_sub ((hxx.const_mul ((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2)).add hkk) hk1,
    average_add (hxx.const_mul ((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2)) hkk,
    average_const_mul,average_const_mul,hz,mul_zero,add_zero] at h
  rw [← average_second hx x,← average_second hk k,← average_derivative hk k] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- The full native theta circle average solves the original hyperbolic Darboux equation. -/
theorem mean_darboux (q : XiZeroCopy) (d x k : ℝ) :
    (Real.sinh d:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => mean q r x k)) d+
      (Real.sinh d:ℂ)*(Real.cosh d:ℂ)*deriv (fun r => mean q r x k) d=
      (Real.sinh d:ℂ)^2*((Real.exp k:ℂ)^2*deriv (deriv (fun r => mean q d r k)) x+
        deriv (deriv (fun r => mean q d x r)) k-deriv (fun r => mean q d x r) k) := by
  rw [mean_radial_action,mean_laplacian_commutes]

private theorem average_constant (c : ℂ) : average (fun _ => c)=c := by
  have hT : 0 ≤ 2*Real.pi := by positivity
  have hpi : (Real.pi:ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
  dsimp [average]

/-!
# Exact fifth and sixth logarithmic jets of the complete theta source

The higher likelihood factor already has a source-coordinate cumulant ladder through order six.
This file identifies that ladder with the actual logarithmic derivatives of the complete theta
source.  Consequently the order-six reflected Hankel polynomial is expressed entirely in the
first Born--Witten atom and literal higher-source cumulants.
-/

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-- Fifth logarithmic jet of the complete theta source in first-atom/source coordinates. -/
def thetaCuspFullLogJetFive (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -thetaCuspBornWittenLogFifthDerivative 1 x +
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFive x

/-- Sixth logarithmic jet of the complete theta source in first-atom/source coordinates. -/
def thetaCuspFullLogJetSix (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -thetaCuspBornWittenLogSixthDerivative 1 x +
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetSix x

/-- Exact fifth logarithmic derivative of the actual complete theta source. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_five_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    iteratedDeriv 5 thetaCuspLogSource x = thetaCuspFullLogJetFive x := by
  have heq : iteratedDeriv 4 thetaCuspLogSource =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun y : ℝ =>
        -thetaCuspBornWittenLogFourthDerivative 1 y +
          thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour y) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    rw [iteratedDeriv_four_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_factor hy,
      thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour_eq_higherLikelihoodLogJetFour hy]
  have hfirst :=
    (hasDerivAt_thetaCuspBornWittenLogFourthDerivative
      (n := 1) (by norm_num) hx.le).neg
  have hhigher := hasDerivAt_thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour
    (thetaCuspLikelihoodCoordinate_pos hx.le)
  rw [show 5 = 4 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  exact ((hfirst.add hhigher).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv

/-- Exact sixth logarithmic derivative of the actual complete theta source. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_six_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    iteratedDeriv 6 thetaCuspLogSource x = thetaCuspFullLogJetSix x := by
  have heq : iteratedDeriv 5 thetaCuspLogSource =ᶠ[nhds x]
      thetaCuspFullLogJetFive := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact iteratedDeriv_five_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets hy
  have hfirst :=
    (hasDerivAt_thetaCuspBornWittenLogFifthDerivative
      (n := 1) (by norm_num) hx.le).neg
  have hhigher := hasDerivAt_thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFive
    (thetaCuspLikelihoodCoordinate_pos hx.le)
  have hfull : HasDerivAt thetaCuspFullLogJetFive
      (thetaCuspFullLogJetSix x) x := by
    unfold thetaCuspFullLogJetFive thetaCuspFullLogJetSix
    exact hfirst.add hhigher
  rw [show 6 = 5 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  exact (hfull.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv

/-- Positive-coordinate form of the actual second logarithmic source jet. -/
def thetaCuspFullReflectedLogCurvature (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thetaCuspBornWittenLogCurvature 1 x -
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetTwo x

/-- Positive-coordinate form of the actual fourth logarithmic source jet. -/
def thetaCuspFullReflectedLogFourthJet (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thetaCuspBornWittenLogFourthDerivative 1 x -
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour x

/-- Positive-coordinate form of the actual sixth logarithmic source jet. -/
def thetaCuspFullReflectedLogSixthJet (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  thetaCuspBornWittenLogSixthDerivative 1 x -
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetSix x

/-- Literal order-six reflected Hankel source polynomial for the complete theta source. -/
def thetaCuspFullReflectionSixthCurvature (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let A := thetaCuspFullReflectedLogCurvature x
  let B := thetaCuspFullReflectedLogFourthJet x
  let C := thetaCuspFullReflectedLogSixthJet x
  A * C - B ^ 2 - 18 * A ^ 2 * B + 24 * A ^ 4

/-- The abstract logarithmic order-six Hankel polynomial is exactly the native source
curvature. -/
theorem thetaCuspLogSource_secondSixthHankel_eq_fullReflectionSixthCurvature
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    iteratedDeriv 2 thetaCuspLogSource x *
          iteratedDeriv 6 thetaCuspLogSource x -
        iteratedDeriv 4 thetaCuspLogSource x ^ 2 +
        18 * iteratedDeriv 2 thetaCuspLogSource x ^ 2 *
          iteratedDeriv 4 thetaCuspLogSource x +
        24 * iteratedDeriv 2 thetaCuspLogSource x ^ 4 =
      thetaCuspFullReflectionSixthCurvature x := by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_two_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_factor hx,
    iteratedDeriv_four_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_factor hx,
    iteratedDeriv_six_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets hx,
    ← thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetTwo_eq_higherLikelihoodLogJetTwo hx,
    ← thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour_eq_higherLikelihoodLogJetFour hx]

/-!
# Partitions by occupation numbers and the shift bijection

A partition is recorded by its occupation numbers: `g j` is the number of parts equal to `j + 1`.
Removing one from every part sends the partitions with exactly `n` parts to the partitions with at
most `n` parts and drops the size by exactly `n`.  This single bijection carries both halves of
Euler's generating-function computation for partitions with a prescribed number of parts.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

open Finsupp

noncomputable section

/-- Occupation numbers of a partition: `g j` is the number of parts equal to `j + 1`. -/
abbrev PartConfig := ℕ →₀ ℕ

/-- The number of parts of a configuration. -/
def partCount (g : PartConfig) : ℕ := g.sum fun _ m => m

/-- The size of a configuration: the sum of its parts. -/
def partSize (g : PartConfig) : ℕ := g.sum fun j m => (j + 1) * m

@[simp] theorem partCount_zero : partCount 0 = 0 := by
  rw [partCount, Finsupp.sum_zero_index]

@[simp] theorem partSize_zero : partSize 0 = 0 := by
  rw [partSize, Finsupp.sum_zero_index]

/-! ## Adding one to every part -/

/-- Raise every part by one and adjoin `a` parts equal to one. -/
def unshift (a : ℕ) (h : PartConfig) : PartConfig :=
  Finsupp.single 0 a + Finsupp.mapDomain Nat.succ h

theorem partCount_unshift (a : ℕ) (h : PartConfig) :
    partCount (unshift a h) = a + partCount h := by
  rw [unshift, partCount, Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl),
    Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl,
    Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)]
  rfl

theorem partSize_unshift (a : ℕ) (h : PartConfig) :
    partSize (unshift a h) = a + (partSize h + partCount h) := by
  rw [unshift, partSize, Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => by ring) (fun _ _ _ => by ring),
    Finsupp.sum_single_index (by ring),
    Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (fun _ => by ring) (fun _ _ _ => by ring)]
  have hsplit : (h.sum fun a b => (Nat.succ a + 1) * b)
      = (h.sum fun a b => (a + 1) * b) + h.sum fun _ b => b := by
    rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
    refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun j _ => ?_
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    ring
  rw [hsplit, partSize, partCount]
  ring

/-! ## Removing one from every part -/

/-- Lower every part by one, discarding the parts equal to one. -/
def shift (g : PartConfig) : PartConfig :=
  Finsupp.comapDomain Nat.succ g (Nat.succ_injective.injOn)

@[simp] theorem shift_apply (g : PartConfig) (j : ℕ) : shift g j = g (j + 1) :=
  Finsupp.comapDomain_apply _ _ _ _

theorem unshift_shift (g : PartConfig) : unshift (g 0) (shift g) = g := by
  refine Finsupp.ext fun j => ?_
  rcases j with _ | k
  · rw [unshift, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_notin_range _ _ (by simp)]
    simp
  · rw [unshift, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by simp),
      Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.succ_injective]
    simp

theorem partCount_eq (g : PartConfig) : partCount g = g 0 + partCount (shift g) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← unshift_shift g]
  rw [partCount_unshift]

theorem partSize_eq (g : PartConfig) :
    partSize g = g 0 + (partSize (shift g) + partCount (shift g)) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← unshift_shift g]
  rw [partSize_unshift]

theorem partCount_shift_le (g : PartConfig) : partCount (shift g) ≤ partCount g := by
  rw [partCount_eq g]
  exact Nat.le_add_left _ _

/-- **The size drops by exactly the number of parts.** -/
theorem partSize_eq_add_partSize_shift {n : ℕ} {g : PartConfig} (hg : partCount g = n) :
    partSize g = n + partSize (shift g) := by
  have hc := partCount_eq g
  rw [hg] at hc
  rw [partSize_eq g]
  omega

theorem shift_unshift (a : ℕ) (h : PartConfig) : shift (unshift a h) = h := by
  refine Finsupp.ext fun j => ?_
  rw [shift_apply, unshift, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by simp),
    Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.succ_injective]
  simp

/-! ## The bijection -/

/-- **Removing one from every part** is a bijection from the configurations with exactly `n` parts
to the configurations with at most `n` parts. -/
def shiftEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    {g : PartConfig // partCount g = n} ≃ {h : PartConfig // partCount h ≤ n} where
  toFun g := ⟨shift g.1, by
    have h1 := partCount_shift_le g.1
    have h2 := g.2
    omega⟩
  invFun h := ⟨unshift (n - partCount h.1) h.1, by
    rw [partCount_unshift]
    have hle := h.2
    omega⟩
  left_inv g := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show unshift (n - partCount (shift g.1)) (shift g.1) = g.1
    have hc := partCount_eq g.1
    rw [g.2] at hc
    have h0 : n - partCount (shift g.1) = g.1 0 := by omega
    rw [h0, unshift_shift]
  right_inv h := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show shift (unshift (n - partCount h.1) h.1) = h.1
    rw [shift_unshift]

@[simp] theorem shiftEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (g : {g : PartConfig // partCount g = n}) :
    ((shiftEquiv n) g).1 = shift g.1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem shiftEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (h : {h : PartConfig // partCount h ≤ n}) :

  ext n ; simp [nnabla, mul_sub]

lemma nnabla_cast (u : ℝ → E) [Sub E] : nnabla u ∘ ((↑) : ℕ → ℝ) = nnabla (u ∘ (↑)) := by
  ext n ; simp [nnabla]

lemma Finset.sum_shift_front {E : Type*} [Ring E] {u : ℕ → E} {n : ℕ} :
    cumsum u (n + 1) = u 0 + cumsum (shift u) n := by
  simp_rw [add_comm n, cumsum, sum_range_add, sum_range_one, add_comm 1] ; rfl

lemma Finset.sum_shift_front' {E : Type*} [Ring E] {u : ℕ → E} :
    shift (cumsum u) = (fun _ => u 0) + cumsum (shift u) := by
  ext n ; apply Finset.sum_shift_front

lemma Finset.sum_shift_back {E : Type*} [Ring E] {u : ℕ → E} {n : ℕ} :
    cumsum u (n + 1) = cumsum u n + u n := by
  simp [cumsum, Finset.range_add_one, add_comm]

lemma Finset.sum_shift_back' {E : Type*} [Ring E] {u : ℕ → E} :
    shift (cumsum u) = cumsum u + u := by
  ext n ; apply Finset.sum_shift_back

lemma summation_by_parts {E : Type*} [Ring E] {a A b : ℕ → E} (ha : a = nabla A) {n : ℕ} :
    cumsum (a * b) (n + 1) = A (n + 1) * b n - A 0 * b 0 -
    cumsum (shift A * fun i => (b (i + 1) - b i)) n := by
  have l1 : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), A (x + 1) * b x = ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n,
      A (x + 1) * b x + A (n + 1) * b n :=
    Finset.sum_shift_back
  have l2 : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), A x * b x = A 0 * b 0 + ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n,
      A (x + 1) * b (x + 1) :=
    Finset.sum_shift_front
  simp only [cumsum, ha, Pi.mul_apply, nabla, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, l1, l2, shift,
    mul_sub]
  abel

lemma summation_by_parts' {E : Type*} [Ring E] {a b : ℕ → E} {n : ℕ} :
    cumsum (a * b) (n + 1) = cumsum a (n + 1) * b n - cumsum (shift (cumsum a) * nabla b) n := by
  simpa using! summation_by_parts (a := a) (b := b) (A := cumsum a) (by simp)

lemma summation_by_parts'' {E : Type*} [Ring E] {a b : ℕ → E} :
    shift (cumsum (a * b)) = shift (cumsum a) * b - cumsum (shift (cumsum a) * nabla b) := by
  ext n ; apply summation_by_parts'

lemma summable_iff_bounded {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :

lemma BoundedAtFilter.add_const {u : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} :

lemma BoundedAtFilter.comp_add {u : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ} :
    BoundedAtFilter atTop (fun n => u (n + N)) ↔ BoundedAtFilter atTop u := by
  simp only [BoundedAtFilter, isBigO_iff, norm_eq_abs, Pi.one_apply,
    eventually_atTop]
  constructor <;> intro ⟨C, n₀, h⟩ <;> use C
  · refine ⟨n₀ + N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (m := N) (n := n) (by grind)
